-- Selecting movie details along with actors, budget, revenue, and abstract
SELECT 
    m.name AS movie_name,
    p.name AS actor_name,
    m.budget,
    m.revenue,
    ma_en.abstract AS english_abstract
FROM 
    movies m
-- Joining with casts to get the actors
LEFT JOIN 
    casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
-- Joining with people to get the actor names
LEFT JOIN 
    people p ON c.person_id = p.id
-- Joining with movie_abstracts_en to get the English abstract
LEFT JOIN 
    movie_abstracts_en ma_en ON m.id = ma_en.movie_id
WHERE 
    m.name = 'Ithaca'
ORDER BY 
    p.name NULLS LAST -- Ordering by actor name, putting NULLs last
LIMIT 10; -- Limiting the result to 10 rows
